body.content: The grid-based approach fails because any arithmetic progression in coordinates creates collinear triples. To achieve a non-zero minimum area, we need a construction that actively avoids all lines, possibly using algebraic constructions with irrational coordinates or perturbation methods that break symmetry. The floor of 0.005 suggests that a slightly perturbed grid or a specific non-uniform distribution might suffice, but proving it requires checking all 286 combinations.
body.possible_next_move: Simulate a perturbed grid where points are displaced by small irrational amounts (e.g., multiples of sqrt(2)/1000) to break collinearities, then compute the exact minimum area.
body.unfinished: Does there exist a simple deterministic perturbation of the 4x4 grid that guarantees min area > 0.005 for 13 points?
